data: {"type":"agent_chunk","agent":"synthesizer","content":"## How CRISPR Gene Editing Works

CRISPR/Cas9 is adapted from a bacterial immune system that cuts up invading viral DNA. Researchers have repurposed it to change chosen letters in an organism's DNA [1]. A guide RNA locates the target DNA, and the Cas9 protein cuts it at that spot [2].

## Where It Is Used

Scientists most often use CRISPR to knock out a gene, and increasingly to replace disease-causing mutations with a repair template [3]. Most of this work is preclinical, done in mouse embryos, cells grown in dishes, or stem cells [1]. Reported applications include eliminating HIV in cell culture [4] and an FDA review of a CRISPR treatment for sickle cell disease [5].

## Caveats

- The shift toward repair templates and the HIV cell-culture result each rest on a single cited source, so corroborate them before relying on them.
- The FDA review has no date in the research. Its status as of November 2026 is unknown and may have changed.
- The research does not cover safety. Off-target edits and delivery risks are central to any move toward clinical use and need separate treatment.

### Sources

1. [RACGP - What is CRISPR gene editing – and how does it work?](https://www1.racgp.org.au/newsgp/clinical/what-is-crispr-gene-editing-%E2%80%93-and-how-does-it-work) - Web, www1.racgp.org.au
2. [Mechanism and Applications of CRISPR/Cas-9-Mediated Genome Editing](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8388126) - Web, pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov
3. [What is CRISPR? - Innovative Genomics Institute (IGI)](https://innovativegenomics.org/what-is-crispr) - Web, innovativegenomics.org
4. [HIV in cell culture can be completely eliminated using CRISPR-Cas gene editing (pdf)](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=39761283) - Hacker News, 324 points, 77 comments, Mar 2024
5. [FDA considers first CRISPR gene editing treatment that may cure sickle cell](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=38354939) - Hacker News, 300 points, 124 comments, Nov 2023
6. [CRISPR gene editing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CRISPR_gene_editing) - Wikipedia
"}
